reviews.title: Pushes good air
reviews.comment: Used this fan to mount to a radiator for a portable ice chest AC cooler. Very good fan so far and moves a lot of air. Noise level for my set up is ok. I may make a smaller version using this fan again. It was a huge upgrade over a basic one I had on hand.
reviews.author: Daniel S.

reviews.title: Very impressed. Seriously powerful!
reviews.comment: These fans SUCK (in the best possible way!). Noise level is really not an issue, and I'm using twelve of them! I have these 12 fans installed to suck warm air out of my apartment/workspace (lots of computer and video equipment generating a lot of heat). Cool air blows right in through the front door (from the AC-cooled air of my apartment building!) Nice! My own AC unit isn't working well, and getting it fixed would mean a massive upheaval and moving a ton of equipment, so this is a great workaround. I initially bought some cheap 5" fans, which were soooo weak, but after some research I bought these and I really couldn't be happier. A+++
reviews.author: Neil Matthews

reviews.title: High Volume Fan
reviews.comment: Excellent Fan, Very High Quality. The fan runs perfectly and moves a ton of air.  Is a little noisy, but other than that, I'm satisfied.
reviews.author: Alan Bailey

reviews.title: Great fans
reviews.comment: Works great! Have 2 set up and they are a tad loud but move air. Took a chunk out of my finger thats how strong they are🤣
